summary: Hezbollah launched a quadcopter drone toward an Israeli engineering vehicle in the Rashaya al-Deir area overnight, causing no casualties and violating the Lebanon ceasefire agreement. Joint Saudi-US airstrikes in Iraq killed at least 12 pro-Iranian militia members and four IRGC advisors in Karbala. Iran reportedly plans to receive 400 Chinese missile systems within weeks, breaching prior commitments. A former Israeli military intelligence officer was arrested for spying on behalf of Iran. Cross-border tensions remain high across Lebanon, Gaza, and the broader region.
key_points: Hezbollah fired a quadcopter drone at an Israeli engineering vehicle in Rashaya al-Deir overnight; no Israeli casualties reported (Source: @almogboker78/17847).
Joint Saudi-US airstrikes in Iraq killed at least 12 pro-Iranian militia members overnight (Source: @inon_yttach/9719).
Four IRGC members were killed in joint Saudi-US strikes on Karbala, Iraq (Source: @shin_persian/8645).
Iran is set to receive 400 Chinese missile systems within weeks, violating prior commitments (Source: @kianmeli1/90245).
A former Israeli military intelligence officer was arrested for spying on behalf of Iran (Source: @manniefabian/58886).
Israeli forces shot dead a suspect approaching troops in southern Lebanon near Ras al-Bayada (Source: @manniefabian/58877).
Hezbollah launched another quadcopter drone toward Israeli forces in Rashaya al-Deir, confirming ongoing violations (Source: @inon_yttach/9727).
IDF Chief of Staff stated readiness for continued warfare across all fronts, including deeper operations in Lebanon (Source: @manniefabian/58892).

sections.executive_summary: Hezbollah launched a quadcopter drone at an Israeli engineering vehicle in Rashaya al-Deir overnight, causing no casualties but violating the Lebanon ceasefire. Joint Saudi-US airstrikes in Iraq killed at least 12 pro-Iranian militia members and four IRGC advisors in Karbala. Iran is reportedly set to receive 400 Chinese missile systems within weeks, breaching prior commitments. A former Israeli military intelligence officer was arrested for spying on behalf of Iran, highlighting internal security threats.
iran: Iran is reportedly set to receive 400 Chinese missile systems within weeks, violating a direct commitment made by Chinese President to former US President Donald Trump not to arm Iran (Source: @kianmeli1/90245).

Four IRGC members were confirmed killed in joint Saudi-US airstrikes on Karbala, Iraq, identified as Ali Asghar Astaneh, Abolfazl Mottaqi, Morteza Akbari, and Amir Abbas Darham Foroush, all from Kashan (Source: @shin_persian/8645).
Iranian-backed Islamic Resistance in Iraq claimed retaliation is inevitable following recent joint Saudi-US strikes targeting pro-Iranian militias (Source: @shin_persian/8641).
Iranian ground forces are highlighted as safeguarding national territory, particularly in southern regions, amid ongoing regional tensions (Source: @presstv/200785).

CENTCOM reported that since early May, approximately 1,000 vessels and 500 million barrels of crude oil have transited with US military assistance, countering Iranian claims in the Persian Gulf (Source: @shin_persian/8643).
israel: A former Israeli military intelligence officer, who served in a classified unit during mandatory and reserve duty, was arrested and charged with contacting an Iranian intelligence agent and attempting to recruit a soldier (Source: @manniefabian/58886).

IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir stated during a visit to southern Lebanon that the military is prepared for the campaign to continue across all fronts and may push deeper into Lebanese territory if required (Source: @manniefabian/58892).

Israeli forces shot dead a suspect identified as Shadi Hussayan al-Darwish between Mansouri and Ras al-Bayada in the Tyre area after he approached troops in a threatening manner (Source: @manniefabian/58877).
Hezbollah launched a quadcopter drone toward an Israeli engineering vehicle in Rashaya al-Deir overnight; no Israeli personnel were injured (Source: @almogboker78/17847).
IDF confirmed that Hezbollah fired a quadcopter drone at an Israeli engineering vehicle in Rashaya al-Deir, marking a violation of the Lebanon ceasefire agreement (Source: @inon_yttach/9727).
IDF conducted airstrikes on multiple Hamas weapons storage sites in central and northern Gaza, including one located inside a mosque in northern Gaza (Source: @New_security8200/203057).
gaza_west_bank: IDF targeted and destroyed several Hamas weapons storage facilities in central and northern Gaza, including one embedded inside a mosque in northern Gaza (Source: @New_security8200/203057).
The IDF emphasized that Hamas uses civilian infrastructure, including religious sites, to store weapons and launch attacks against Israeli forces and civilians (Source: @New_security8200/203057).
No specific incidents were reported in the West Bank during this reporting period based on available source data.
IDF forces continue operating in the southern Gaza border area in accordance with operational plans to neutralize threats (Source: @New_security8200/203057).
lebanon: Hezbollah launched a quadcopter drone toward an Israeli engineering vehicle in Rashaya al-Deir overnight, causing no casualties but constituting a violation of the Lebanon ceasefire agreement (Source: @almogboker78/17847).
Israeli forces shot dead a suspect near Ras al-Bayada in the Tyre area after he approached troops in a manner deemed threatening (Source: @manniefabian/58877).
IDF troops seized Hezbollah weapons in the southern Lebanon buffer zone, including assault rifles, RPGs, and explosive devices (Source: @manniefabian/58877).
IDF Chief of Staff stated that if required, Israeli forces will push deeper into Lebanese territory to address threats (Source: @manniefabian/58892).
syria_iraq: Joint Saudi-US airstrikes in Iraq killed at least 12 pro-Iranian militia members overnight, according to Iraqi sources (Source: @inon_yttach/9719).
Four IRGC advisors were killed in joint Saudi-US strikes on Karbala, Iraq, identified as members of Kashan origin (Source: @shin_persian/8645).
The IRGC-backed Islamic Resistance in Iraq threatened retaliation, stating their response is inevitable following recent joint strikes (Source: @shin_persian/8641).

The Popular Mobilization Forces (Hashd al-Shaabi) declared readiness to implement all directives of the commander-in-chief to confront any aggression targeting Iraq and its security institutions (Source: @naya_foriraq/86227).
gulf_states: Saudi Arabia participated in joint airstrikes with the US in Iraq targeting pro-Iranian militias, resulting in multiple casualties (Source: @inon_yttach/9719).
A drone attack on an LNG carrier at Egypt's Damietta port caused fires on two vessels; one drone struck a floating storage unit (Source: @asafroz/52058).
Yemen is reportedly considering imposing fees on commercial vessels transiting the Bab el-Mandeb Strait and southern Red Sea (Source: @SharghDaily/175170).

CENTCOM reported that since early May, approximately 1,000 vessels and 500 million barrels of crude oil have transited with US military support through the Persian Gulf region (Source: @shin_persian/8643).

sections.threat_assessment: Regional tensions are escalating rapidly across multiple fronts. Hezbollah's repeated drone attacks on Israeli positions in southern Lebanon indicate a deliberate campaign to test the ceasefire boundaries. Iran's imminent acquisition of 400 Chinese missile systems significantly enhances its long-range strike capability, potentially altering the regional balance. Joint Saudi-US operations in Iraq signal increased coordination against Iranian proxies, likely provoking further retaliation. The arrest of an Israeli spy within military intelligence underscores ongoing penetration risks. These developments suggest a high probability of expanded conflict in the near term.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia and the United States have intensified joint military operations in Iraq targeting Iranian-backed militias, demonstrating a coordinated strategy to degrade proxy capabilities. Israel has responded to Hezbollah provocations with targeted strikes and enhanced defensive postures along the Lebanese border. Iran continues to escalate through arms procurement and proxy mobilization, including threats from Iraqi resistance groups. Egypt is investigating a drone attack on critical energy infrastructure, highlighting vulnerabilities in Gulf shipping lanes. The broader international community remains focused on preventing a regional conflagration while managing ongoing conflicts in Gaza and Ukraine.
sections.intelligence_notes: Israeli military intelligence detected and responded to Hezbollah drone activity in real-time, indicating robust surveillance capabilities along the Lebanese border. The capture of Hezbollah weapons caches in southern Lebanon suggests ongoing efforts to stockpile arms in violation of UN resolutions. Iranian procurement of Chinese missile systems represents a strategic shift toward advanced conventional weaponry. The involvement of multiple US regional commands (CENTCOM) in maritime security operations demonstrates integrated deterrence efforts. Intelligence sharing between Saudi Arabia and the US appears to be yielding actionable targeting data against Iranian proxies. Internal security breaches within Israel's military intelligence community require immediate counterintelligence review.
